name: my-provider-dash-manager
description: Multi-account manager for 37 cloud services (Vercel, Netlify, Supabase, Cloudflare, AWS, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, Gmail). One free Windows desktop app, each account in its own isolated browser session, with ad-blocking, dark mode, encrypted saved logins and silent updates. Install with npx my-provider-dash-manager.

paragraphs: For freelancers, agencies and developers running client plus personal infrastructure: one desktop app for every account you own. Keep several Google, Microsoft, AWS, Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare, Supabase, GitHub, npm, Stripe, Gmail, Outlook and Proton Mail accounts (37 services built in, any site by URL) signed in at the same time, each in a fully isolated session, and switch between them instantly — the way a browser handles tabs, but built around accounts instead of pages.
Windows desktop app · Electron 43 · local-first · no telemetry, no account, no server · source-available licence: free for personal and commercial use

Further down Home: the Add an account picker with every built-in service you are not using yet (37 in total, or add any site by URL), the Updates panel with the installed version, and the saved-login controls. Install with npx my-provider-dash-manager or straight from Releases — see Install.
features: Unlimited accounts per service. Each account gets its own storage partition — separate
cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB and cache. Accounts can never see each other's session.
Sessions persist across restarts. Sign in once; you stay signed in (verified by an automated
restart test that counts real cookies after relaunch).
Instant switching. Active tabs stay warm, so switching is a visibility toggle, not a reload.
